title: Add a browser script
summary: A script tag can run client-side JavaScript on an Astro page.
introduction: A script tag can run client-side JavaScript on an Astro page. Your task: Change the reply message.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for add a browser script

blocks.text: A script tag can run client-side JavaScript on an Astro page. Use it only for the page behaviour you actually need.
Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.
Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`addEventListener` waits for the named event before calling the function you pass to it.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: The button updates the paragraph in the browser.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: If a component repeats on a page, repeated ids can cause trouble. Use a custom element or scoped selection for repeated controls.
